review_findings.a1fe0c6e: PASS on first review. Gates green, criteria met, sweeps clean.
review_findings.69ffdcf8: R1 FAIL [low]: stale dependency wording at docs/tutorials/first-workflow.md:270 describes readiness as dependencies 'done' rather than terminal. REQ-4 is a sweep criterion; the worker's sweep and the lead's Tier 2.5 sweep both grepped 'not Done' patterns and missed 'all dependencies done'. R2 FAIL: dependency.rs doc comment + docs echoes. Lead traced root cause to errors.rs:827 shipping the literal string 'incomplete dependencies'. Fixed at source to 'unmet dependencies', matching the existing unmet_dependencies JSON field. R3 PASS.
review_findings.50677708: R1 FAIL [medium]: newly public graph APIs lack the mandatory '# Examples' doc sections (scripts/code-review-prompt.md:61). Functional criteria all met. R2 PASS.
review_findings.2f447380: R1 FAIL [high]: apply holds .git/jit/locks/apply.lock while ordinary writers hold .jit/.index.lock, so the apply lock excludes no one and compensation-rollback can erase concurrent writes. Also absent entirely outside a git repo. Lead confirmed independently against storage/json.rs:508 and commands/mod.rs:1054. R2 FAIL [high]: rollback restored via save_issue, which stamps updated_at, so a failed apply left observable change. Fixed with IssueStore::restore_issue_verbatim. R3 PASS.
